headline.en: FS KKR Capital Corp Declares $0.44 Quarterly and $0.20 Special Distribution
headline.zh: FS KKR Capital Corp 宣派每股 0.44 美元季度分派及每股 0.20 美元特别分派

summary.en: FS KKR Capital Corp (NYSE: FSK) said its board declared a fourth quarter 2026 distribution of $0.44 per share, payable on or about December 24, 2026 to holders of record on December 16, 2026. The board also declared a special distribution of $0.20 per share, representing a portion of estimated accumulated spillback income, payable on or about December 15, 2026 to holders of record on December 1, 2026. FSK said it will release third quarter 2026 results and host a call on November 5, 2026.
summary.zh: FS KKR Capital Corp（NYSE: FSK）表示，董事会宣派 2026 年第四季度分派每股 0.44 美元，将于 2026 年 12 月 24 日前后支付给 2026 年 12 月 16 日登记在册的股东。董事会还宣派每股 0.20 美元的特别分派，相当于估计累计溢出收益的一部分，将于 2026 年 12 月 15 日前后支付给 2026 年 12 月 1 日登记在册的股东。FSK 表示将于 2026 年 11 月 5 日发布 2026 年第三季度业绩并召开电话会议。

items.source_headline: FS KKR Capital Corp files 8-K: items 7.01 and 9.01
items.relevance_reason: FS KKR Capital Corp, an FSK-managed BDC, declares a regular quarterly distribution and a special spillback distribution, a modest capital-return datapoint for the listed BDC sub-sector.

headline.en: ASIC halts offers in three more ASCF private credit funds
headline.zh: ASIC叫停另外三只ASCF私人信贷基金的发行

summary.en: Australia's ASIC has issued an interim stop order on the product disclosure statements for three private credit funds managed by Australian Secure Capital Fund: the ASCF Premium Capital Fund, ASCF Select Income Fund and ASCF High Yield Fund. The order prevents ASCF from offering, issuing, selling or transferring interests in the funds, with ASIC citing inadequate disclosure of loan portfolio and diversification metrics, a possible misleading and deceptive statement, and insufficient disclosure of an investor reserve account covering impairments and capital losses. As of 30 June the three funds had A$251.8m in assets under management.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚证券与投资委员会（ASIC）对Australian Secure Capital Fund（ASCF）管理的三只私人信贷基金——ASCF Premium Capital Fund、ASCF Select Income Fund和ASCF High Yield Fund——的产品披露声明（PDS）发出临时停止令。截至6月30日，这三只基金管理资产为2.518亿澳元。

items.source_headline: ASIC halts offers in three more private credit funds

reason.en: ASIC placed interim stop orders blocking offers in three ASCF private credit funds over alleged PDS disclosure failures, an adverse regulatory action in Australian private credit.
reason.zh: ASIC以涉嫌PDS披露失当为由，对三只ASCF私人信贷基金发出临时停止令，禁止其发行，是澳大利亚私人信贷领域的负面监管行动。

items.relevance_reason: ASIC's interim stop orders on three ASCF private credit funds and its wider crackdown signal rising Australian private credit regulatory and retail-distribution risk.
